subject: Money
title: Capital Gains Tax
description: A 60-second lesson on Capital Gains Tax.

hook.text: Warren Buffett pays a lower tax rate than his secretary. He said so himself in 2011.

buildup.text: Income from wages is taxed up to 37%. Income from investments held over a year is taxed at just 20%.

discovery.text: Capital gains tax is lower because governments want to encourage investment and risk-taking.

twist.text: But most stock is owned by the wealthy. Lower capital gains rates mainly benefit the top 10%.

climax.text: The debate: does low capital gains tax grow the economy, or does it just grow inequality?

punchline.text: How you earn decides how much you keep.

quiz.question: Why is the capital gains tax rate lower than the income tax rate?
